{{Quote|Enemies are not accidental or unfortunate. We make them, we earn them, and we nurture them, whether we realize it or not. If we can't find real enemies, we'll invent them and make them as big as we can. They become our justification for existing, or excuses for our own failings. Many of us would suffer if we didn't have them - who would need Jedi if there were no dark Force users?|Lord Gajakur Biul|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>}}
Lord '''Gajakur Biul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who was affiliated with the [[Kilian Rangers/Legends|Kilian Rangers]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
One of Biul's mantras regarding war is used at the head of a chapter in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novel]].
